current_activity: 277th Division falls back to a line 1.5 miles from Villedieu-les-Bailleul and breaks out toward the Dives that night
notes: Event date: Breakout and Pursuit ch. 27 p. 551: after the 12th SS Panzer Division pulled out of the line early on 20 August the 277th fell back to a curved line facing west and northwest about one and a half miles from Villedieu-les-Bailleul, and stayed there the rest of the day; about 2300 Colonel Wilhelm Viebig decided to break out; about 900 men moved to a crossing site on the Dives northwest of St. Lambert. Location: Villedieu-les-Bailleul, one and a half miles away. Commander: Colonel Wilhelm Viebig (ch. 27 p. 551).
